run_robot_interface_init: run a python script that initializes a RobotInterface connected to localhost
run_go_home: run a python script that resets a robot to its home position using go_home
run_get_ee_pose: run a python script that gets the robot end-effector position and orientation
run_move_to_ee_pose: run a python script that moves the robot end-effector to a desired XYZ position
run_ee_pose_workflow: run a python script that gets current ee pose, moves to a new position, and verifies
